scope: Public Betfair horse-racing historical help samples; file-format and offline research feasibility audit

datasets.access_note: Publisher-linked public sample downloaded without account or payment. No redistribution licence established; raw file is ignored by Git.

audit.format: bz2-compressed JSON Lines; each line is a market-change message; no TAR wrapper

timestamp_semantics.pt: Publisher timestamp in Unix epoch milliseconds; UTC conversion verified numerically. Proxy for source availability, not local receipt or physical race-event time.
timestamp_semantics.marketTime: Scheduled market start in UTC, not observed actual off.
timestamp_semantics.received_at: Absent. Network and local processing latency cannot be measured.
timestamp_semantics.inPlay: Observed market-definition transition; its first appearance differs across package sampling.
timestamp_semantics.sampling: Changes are sparse and may be conflated; do not manufacture ticks or assume every message contains every field.

datasets.permitted_use_status: Publisher provides public help sample for inspection; no open-data or redistribution licence established. Keep raw local/ignored; use this sample for format and framework smoke checks only.
unsupported_uses: Estimating generalizable ROI from one selected 2017 meeting
Treating LTP, a touched level, or aggregate traded volume as proof of a fill
Measuring physical event-to-publisher or network/receipt latency
Independent cross-provider entity-history edge: all acquired exchange data originate with Betfair
Assuming all 34 related markets are independent races
Applying old marketBaseRate as the current account commission rate

image_audit.interpretation: All image messages contain marketDefinition, but images can omit ltp for some ACTIVE runners. Resetting prior cache then rebuilding yields legitimately incomplete LTP snapshots; do not forward-fill from pre-image state to manufacture completeness.

linkage_audit.scope: Format/identity feasibility only; not an authorized reusable strategy benchmark or evidence of edge
linkage_audit.rule_tested: CSV EVENT_ID == stream market ID after removing leading 1.; CSV SELECTION_ID == stream runner id. This is an observed sample mapping, not an assumed universal contract.
linkage_audit.bsp_difference_note: Differences in 55 rows are all <0.01; stream values appear truncated to two decimals for these rows. Do not require byte-equal BSP to establish identity.
linkage_audit.time_interpretation: CSV times have no offset; all 112 linked rows are one hour ahead of UTC stream marketTime, consistent with Europe/London summer time on this date. Not proof of a global timezone contract.
linkage_audit.filename_date_note: SP file 2017-04-29 contains 2017-04-28 event dates; file 2017-04-30 contains 2017-04-29 event dates. Never infer event date from filename.
